games.title: Color Word Challenge
games.short_description: Tap the ink color instead of the word and score as many correct answers as possible in 30 seconds.
games.description: Color Word Challenge is a 30-second Stroop-style brain sprint. Read the word, ignore its meaning, tap the actual ink color, protect the clock from wrong answers, and replay for a higher score or friend challenge.

games.title: Direction Switch
games.short_description: Follow or reverse the arrow as the rule changes and score as many correct calls as possible in 30 seconds.
games.description: Direction Switch is a 30-second cognitive-flexibility challenge. Tap the arrow direction when the rule says FOLLOW, tap the opposite direction when it says REVERSE, and chase a higher score while wrong answers cost time.

games.title: Five Second Sense
games.short_description: Stop an invisible timer as close to exactly five seconds as possible and challenge a friend to get closer.
games.description: Five Second Sense is an ultra-short timing challenge with no visible countdown. Start the timer, trust your internal clock, stop as close to exactly five seconds as possible, then retry or share the result as a friend challenge.

games.title: Number Hunt
games.short_description: Find and tap shuffled numbers in order as fast as possible during a 30-second visual search sprint.
games.description: Number Hunt is a 30-second visual-search game. Scan a shuffled 4x4 board, tap the numbers in sequence, clear boards for deeper runs, and minimize wrong taps that cost time while chasing a higher score.

games.title: Pair Flip
games.short_description: Flip cards, find matching symbol pairs, and clear as many boards as possible in 45 seconds.
games.description: Pair Flip is a 45-second memory-matching challenge. Reveal cards, remember positions, find symbol pairs, earn a board-clear bonus, and keep replaying to improve the score or send a friend challenge.

games.title: Parity Rush
games.short_description: Classify numbers as odd or even as fast as possible during a 30-second speed challenge.
games.description: Parity Rush is a 30-second number-classification sprint. Decide odd or even, protect the timer from wrong answers, adapt as the number range grows, and replay or share a score challenge.
